title: Quiz Generator
prompt: Generate quizzes with various question types (multiple choice, true/false, short answer, essay). Include answer keys and explanations. Ensure questions test understanding, not just memorization.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
prerequisites: Available time, format, and assessment needs
use_case_examples: Design a structured quiz generator experience with objectives, activities, and assessment criteria
Adapt quiz generator content for mixed proficiency learners while preserving measurable outcomes
Create a quiz generator plan that supports retention through spaced practice and feedback loops
success_criteria: Learning objectives are observable and aligned with assessment tasks
Instruction plan includes pacing, differentiation, and feedback checkpoints
Learners can demonstrate mastery of quiz generator outcomes in practice
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
